.. change::
    :tags: usecase, reflection, sqlite
    :tickets: 1058

    When reflecting a SQLite table using a partial column projection such as
    :paramref:`_schema.Table.include_columns`, reflected computed columns now
    carry a :class:`.ComputedReconstruction` state available as
    ``column.computed.reconstruction`` / ``column.reconstruction`` and
    aggregated for the current projection at
    ``table.reconstruction``.  The state preserves the original expression
    text and distinguishes columns directly missing from the projection from
    underlying base columns derived transitively through another missing
    generated column, without adding excluded columns back to the reflected
    :class:`_schema.Table`.  DDL generation/emission for a projection that
    cannot be reconstructed raises a clear error before an unusable CREATE
    statement is sent; the preserved expression may still be rendered using
    ``compile_kwargs={"render_incomplete_computed": True}``.  Expression
    extraction now also supports the SQLite shorthand ``AS (...)`` form and
    identifies references with a tokenizer that ignores string literals,
    comments and function names.
